claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.targetTypeFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring modifies the Fear spell to affect Beasts only. grant_spell_access has no field to express a creature-type restriction on the spell as cast from the item. Without this field the encoding would claim Fear targets any creature, which is materially wrong and would produce incorrect combat outcomes.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixedDc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring specifies a fixed save DC of 13, independent of the wearer's spellcasting ability. grant_spell_access has no dcSource or fixedDc field; the atom provides no mechanism to override the default caster_spell_save_dc. A new field (e.g., fixedDc: number or dcSource: DcSource) is needed to express item-defined DCs.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 charge to cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it
